subject.title: refactor: finish retained plugin SDK demotions

question: Should these five shipped public SDK entrypoints remain available through a tagged migration window, or does the project explicitly approve removing them before the stated July 30, 2026 boundary?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes a shipped external plugin API contract; source and tests can verify implementation mechanics, but only maintainers can approve shortening the externally communicated compatibility window.

options.title: Preserve the migration window
options.body: Keep the five public exports and pending registry records until canonical docs and replacement paths have shipped in a stable release and the declared removal window has elapsed.

options.title: Approve an early breaking removal
options.body: Land the demotions now only with an explicit maintainer decision that the external-plugin upgrade break is acceptable and release communication covers the affected imports.

recommendation.title: Preserve the migration window
recommendation.body: Keep the five public exports and pending registry records until canonical docs and replacement paths have shipped in a stable release and the declared removal window has elapsed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the prior merged compatibility sweep and this follow-up, and is the clearest history-based routing candidate for the intended removal schedule.
